title: Borrowed raw DXF string sink fast slice
mode: local implementation and focused generated verification
scope: Remove the internal dxfWriter raw group-code string ownership copy
Keep ASCII/Binary wire framing and record identity observation unchanged
Prove synchronous consumption of a borrowed subview in both framings

implementation.change: dxfWriter::writeString and its ASCII/Binary overrides now take std::string_view; internal validators and record inventory name helpers consume views, and obsolete moves into the synchronous sink were removed.

commands: cmake --build build-gcc --target libdxfrw_gbk_codepage_tests libdxfrw_writer_primitives_tests libdxfrw_dxf_fixture_tests lc3_compat_check -j2

results.targetTextSelector: PASS: 40 wire, 14 rejection/modern, 40 chunk, 4 framing, 2 compatible-MTEXT, 2 borrowed-view cases; existing profile/cap/raw controls passed

limitations: No throughput, allocator-count or RSS benchmark was run; the change removes copies by construction at the internal call boundary only.
The string_view contract is synchronous and must not be retained by future writer implementations.
The worktree is broadly dirty; the slice is locally verified but uncommitted.
